title: The Algebraic Landscape of Kochen-Specker Sets in Dimension Three
summary: We present a computational survey of Kochen-Specker (KS) uncolorability in three-dimensional Hilbert space across coordinate alphabets drawn from quadratic, cyclotomic, golden-ratio, and cubic Pisot number fields, principally the two-symbol family A = {0, +-1, +-x}. In every tested alphabet, KS sets arise only when x supports a cancellation identity: an algebraic relation making dot products vanish exactly.
